blocks.etymology: From Middle English wifhode, wifhod, wifhede, from Old English wīfhād (“femininity; the female sex”), equivalent to wife + -hood.
vi_block: Cnh làm vợ, cưng vị làm vợ.

wiktionary.gloss: The quality or state of being a wife.
The character or behaviour that befits a good wife; wifeliness.
